description: The third branch, which targets a local OpenAI-compatible server and reuses the same response parsing as OpenAI.

steps.description: Enter the Open WebUI branch. Normalize the base URL (the comment says it trims trailing slashes), then throw if the base URL or the model is missing.
Post to `baseUrl + /api/chat/completions`. The `authorization` header sends a Bearer token only when a key is present, because the page says the key is optional for a local server.
The body sends the configured model, the `messages` array, `max_tokens`, and `temperature`.

Parse and error-check the response, then return `extractOpenAIText(data).trim()`. The comment notes it uses the same `choices[0].message.content` path as OpenAI, because the server speaks the same protocol.

title: Open WebUI / Local Branch
